docs.text: FYI Lake Ontario is doing its deep water thing & is body-numbing cold (at least it was yesterday). If you need to jump into the opposite of the air today, it’s there. (Not downtown tho because Doug ford destroyed the only city centre beach at Ontario place)
Not quite spring yet on Lake Ontario.. ice around the docks but the channel to the lake is clear.

I love how Lake Ontario changes with the winter weather… this is on the other side of the city and then some, but it looks just like home to me except that we can see the opposite shore when we look west (lake curves back around at Hamilton). One day, slushy waves. Next, ice shelf. Pancakes next?

For those new to Toronto: Lake Ontario is still Very Cold. Sure, it's climbed to survivable temperatures, but a high of 13C isn't optimal for swimming fun-times. The sand, on the other hand, will feel like lava. So I guess it all balances out...?
Look I grew up with Lake Ontario just up the road and no it's cold and gross
Spring on the north shore of Lake Ontario. They should at least call it 'winter extended'.
I am close to Lake Ontario. Was freezing today here too.

Yes, there are some nice beaches and stretches of waterfront along Lake Ontario. And yes, they can feel bitterly cold when the wind is blowing off the lake in winter. The city is at its best in summer, IMHO, if you ever get a chance to visit again.
Right? I only have a huge lake. Ontario. Lol... And it's always cold.
You’ve perfectly captured how cold and foreboding Lake Ontario can be in winter.
A lovely calm morning here by Lake Ontario. A few mild days have reduced the ice and snow levels. Birds are singing and returning. Is spring in the air?

The weather is a bit wilder, but I'm close to (but not on the edge of) Lake Ontario where it's more temperate. Snow actually has been less due to global warming. As for immigrating here, a digital nomad visa or student visa is probably your best bet. Once you're here, keep reapplying when needed.
Lake Ontario can get cold. But you get used to the cold quickly especially on a hot summer day.
